title: Nourishing Malaysian Tofu Fried Rice
description: Savor a fragrant, savory tofu fried rice infused with smoky caramelized onions, Dutch stroop, and aromatic Malaysian spices, perfect for a brunch that satisfies both plant-based and indulgent cravings.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large wok over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add the sliced onion and saute until translucent and lightly golden.
Stir in the minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Push the aromatics to the side, pour in the sesame oil, then add the cubed tofu and fry until golden on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Toss in the mixed vegetables and cook until just tender, about 3 minutes.
Push everything to the center, pour in the soy sauce and Dutch stroop, then stir to coat.
Add the cooked jasmine rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry for 4 minutes until well combined and heated through.
In a small bowl, beat the eggs, then pour into the wok, scrambling until just set.
Mix in optional chili slices if using, then sprinkle toasted sesame seeds.
Remove from heat, stir in chopped cilantro, and serve hot with a wedge of lime if desired.
